images.filename: Little Tokyo Racial Composition by Percentage.png
images.caption: Figure 6. This figure breaks down the demographic percentage of the Non-Hispanic White, Non-Hispanic Asian, Non-Hispanic Black, and Hispanics residing in Little Tokyo in 2016. The figure shows the large percentage of Non-Hispanic Asians within Little Tokyo, in comparison to Non-Hispanic whites, which constitutes more than triple the percentage. Along with that, Non-Hispanic Asians surpass both Non-Hispanic Blacks and Hispanics, by double the percentage. Retrieved from 2016 5-Year American Community Survey.
images.alt: Figure 6. This figure breaks down the demographic percentage of the Non-Hispanic White, Non-Hispanic Asian, Non-Hispanic Black, and Hispanics residing in Little Tokyo in 2016. The figure shows the large percentage of Non-Hispanic Asians within Little Tokyo, in comparison to Non-Hispanic whites, which constitutes more than triple the percentage. Along with that, Non-Hispanic Asians surpass both Non-Hispanic Blacks and Hispanics, by double the percentage. Retrieved from 2016 5-Year American Community Survey.

images.caption: Figure 7. This figure shows the percentage of those who own property in Little Tokyo, compared to those who rent property. The graph indicates that a vast amount of those living within the community are almost all renters, with 16% owning homes. Retrieved from 2016 5-Year American Community Survey.

images.caption:
Took this nice landscape [Ed. note: of West Los Angeles, including Hollywood in the foreground and Century City on the horizon just left of center] from the Griffith Park Observatory.
There is some glare around the bottom right of this photo, I try my best to control. 
Love my 50L so much, it shows great detail around the aperture 8.0-11.0
I have Cokin GND 0.9, but I found the color cast is obvious to see before the Photoshop process. Not highly recommended~

No HDR process. Trying the RAW format, you may get more detail than you imagine!
